purpose: Teach: 和訳/恩給/エクササイズ/クオリア/メディカル/性器/転化/近親

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英文資料の和訳を社内で進めろ
lines.en: We need to bring English document translation in-house.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clean attack on the opening. No softening — this is an instruction, not a suggestion. Steady breath control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。退職者の恩給制度を整備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll get our pension system for retiring employees in order.
lines.style: Careful, attentive. Slight pause before the commitment — he's already thinking through what it takes. Steady, reliable cadence. Respectful without sounding strained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のエクササイズ習慣を支援しろ
lines.en: I want our staff wellness and exercise programs expanded.
lines.style: Another directive, but with a slight tonal shift — less transaction, more investment. Still crisp. Lean forward slightly in the voice, like he's testing whether Kenji hears the intent beneath the order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のクオリアを考えた商品設計をします
lines.en: Yes. We'll design products with genuine consideration for what customers actually need.
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation. He's tracking what the boss means. Slower than before, more deliberate — he wants to show he understands the philosophy, not just the task. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、メディカル機器事業も視野に入れろ
lines.en: And medical device manufacturing — I want that on our roadmap.
lines.style: Shift in weight. This one lands differently — bigger move, higher stakes. Direct but not rushed. The kind of statement that expects silence afterward, not immediate agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。性器関連商品の取り扱いには細心の注意を払います
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we handle anything sensitive in that space with absolute care.
lines.style: He catches the weight. Slower still. Each phrase deliberate. Not apologetic, but serious — the voice of someone who understands the responsibility. Breath control steady and low.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、廃材を資源に転化させる事業を進めろ
lines.en: Start an initiative converting waste and scrap into usable resources.
lines.style: Final directive. Voice settles back into the command register. No hesitation. This is the capstone — environmental responsibility framed as business sense. Authoritative close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。近親者間取引のリスク管理を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll put strict protocols in place for managing any dealings with related parties.
lines.style: The final acknowledgment. Kenji has moved from task-receiver to strategic thinker. This one has real weight. Slow, careful delivery. He's committing to something serious. Voice lands on 'strict' with quiet firmness. Slight breath after.
